title: JUST IN LOVE WITH IT
body:
In love with this app and the creators are updating it a lot to make it even more practical and cute. 
There are breathing exercises that actually help to relax or concentrate. 
One of my favourite things about it is that there is an task to name emotion that you're feeling right now and then you get a wide list of possible emotions. It helped me a lot to actually recognise things inside of me that I didn't know about.
author: Trashy_pearl
